results.note: AP (via PBS) reports Trump arrived in Manila on Tuesday 17 Nov; whitehouse.gov/AP hub not readable for a take-off time, so a Monday ET departure inside the window is inferred from a Tuesday Manila arrival (a later take-off cannot arrive Tuesday local, an earlier one would have arrived Monday).

At the 16 Nov regular briefing, spokesperson Mao Ning, asked about 'the announcement of the China-Russia-U.S. Shenzhen Summit', said it 'will be the first ever face-to-face meeting between the Chinese, Russian and U.S. heads of state' and that 'the three presidents will have an in-depth exchange of views'.

ČTK and ČT24 on Babiš's Monday pre-departure remarks: the explicit 'the government will abolish the fees' was his Sunday statement; on Monday he only denied the change was an attack on democracy and said 'we will follow the European Commission directive', which a neutral reader does not take as restating abolition or non-withdrawal (no other Monday statement found).

Interfax's 16 Nov news archive (Peskov on APEC meetings, Trump's remarks, Europeans in talks; Ushakov call with Kushner/Witkoff) and kremlin.ru carry no on-record statement by Putin, Peskov, Ushakov or Lavrov that day that Ukraine must not join NATO; TASS/RIA not searchable in full.

consilium.europa.eu refused scripted reading; ČT24 citing the Council: on 16 Nov the FAC added 145 names: 113 (12 persons, 101 entities) under the Ukraine territorial-integrity regime, 31 (SDA plus 30 persons) under the hybrid-threats regime and NoName057(16) under the cyber regime, so exactly 145 >= 145.

The FlightAware 'yesterday' page and its archive snapshot could not be read in the 17 Nov window (page now shows 17 Nov; archive.org unreachable); NBC (FlightAware, ~300 US cancellations by 9 a.m. ET Monday, American alone 157) and City News Service/heysocal (FlightAware, 530 cancellations into or out of the US by early Monday) put the Monday total above 300 since daily counts only rise.

Iran International (15 Nov 06:34 GMT, i.e. 10:04 Tehran) reports the Majlis voted on Sunday 192-49-4 for single urgency of the bill removing the ijtihad requirement for the intelligence minister; Persian outlets incl. Mehr carried the same.

No report on 15-16 Nov (444 daily archives, hvg.hu Itthon, searches) that a KDNP body suspended or expelled Seszták; only the 14 Nov initiative ('felfüggeszthetik') and Rétvári's call to give up his mandate.

No report by 16 Nov 23:59 that Seszták gave up his seat (444 and hvg.hu coverage of 15-17 Nov mention the Seszták cash case but no resignation; KDNP's Rétvári had only called on him to return the mandate on 14 Nov).
NBS: October 2026 total retail sales of consumer goods 4,646.3 bn yuan, up 0.4% y/y (data first released in the NBS overview of 16 Nov; English detail page dated 17 Nov).
NBS: October 2026 value added of industrial enterprises above designated size rose 4.8% y/y in real terms, below 6.0%; released 16 Nov (overview) so the release was held.
investingLive (15 Nov 23:57 GMT = 16 Nov 08:57 JST) and AP: first preliminary Q3 2026 real GDP -0.1% seasonally adjusted annualised (consensus +0.3%); ESRI page gave no figure in text.
ČSÚ 'Indexy cen výrobců - říjen 2026' (16 Nov, ČTK 10:27): industrial producer prices +0.9% m/m and +4.7% y/y (September +3.7%).
ČSÚ release of 16 Nov puts October industrial producer prices at +4.7% y/y, below 5.0%.

After meeting Netanyahu on 16 Nov Babiš said the Czech Republic should acquire further air-defence systems quickly and the army should decide which; he mentioned Iron Dome, Arrow 3 and Barak and that the delegation met Arrow 3 makers and wants to talk to the Barak maker, but named no system the country wants or is negotiating to buy; Defence Minister Zůna's remark about signing for Spyder All-in-One was a minister's remark, not a Government Office/MoD statement, which the criterion excludes.
ČT24 and ČTK reports of the 16 Nov Babiš-Netanyahu meeting (defence, AI, health talks; joint government session agreed for later) mention no intergovernmental document signed that day.

ČTK (16 Nov 14:08) citing the Finance Ministry's price bulletin issued that day: the diesel cap rises by 35 haléř to CZK 45.73/l for the next two days, above 45.38 (PDF on mf.gov.cz not machine-readable).
ČTK (16 Nov) citing the Finance Ministry's bulletin: the diesel cap from 17 Nov is CZK 45.73/l, 2 haléř below the 45.75 threshold.
